name: Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH)
short_description: A half-marathon race held on November 1, 2026, at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai, Thailand, with distance options ranging from 3km to 21.1km.
ai_summary: The Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai (CMSH) is a half-marathon event organized by Scenic Marathon Series, scheduled for November 1, 2026, at Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai, Thailand. The race offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, making it accessible to a range of runners from casual participants to more serious half-marathon competitors. Registration for the event is currently open.
